activity_summary: You told them you are reading and not beginning. The loaf is a finger short of the notch. The horse is Wednesday, at the Bull, at first light. Tomorrow is the quarter, and the chamber was not settled over the loaf. You put down threepence for the meal. She let you the room, and not the weather on the stair. Brooke stays. The chronicle goes back under the cloth. The bay is still not taken.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the reading, the horse, and the cloth going back.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Asked with the loaf in her hands, and kept the chamber for tomorrow.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Asked after the horse, and offered the cat a message he will not take.

facets.activity: Named Wednesday for the horse and tomorrow for the quarter

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am reading. I am not beginning.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Wednesday, at first light, from the Bull.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: I let you the room, Master Shakespeare. I did not undertake that the weather should remain outside the stair.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Here is the threepence for the meal.
